authority: Official PyTorch v2.11.0 source; parent reads independently of the subagent
verified_findings: Explicit CPU CSR sum initializes a zero output and dispatches to spmm_reduce_stub.
The specialized kernel makes its right-hand operand contiguous and accumulates inside CSR loops.
The default helper's per-entry cpublas::axpy and non-MKL transpose path were independently read through official GitHub source.
The optional Eigen sparse wrapper may replace operand index tensors; build-time availability must not be inferred from USE_EIGEN_FOR_BLAS.
The installed CPU wheel rejects the nonempty CSR-by-CSR probe; only the empty-input shortcut completed.
limits: Source inspection explains dispatched algorithms; installed-operation profiles and probes supply measured behavior. No binary-level, whole-trajectory or new comparator-mode certification.
